catalyst.head: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Wood makes it grow.
catalyst.current_tail: As a catalyst, the intake falls behind the output, and you would rather puzzle an answer out alone than take one from a teacher. Either way you run dry before you feel taught.

friction.head: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Growing is what Wood makes of it.
friction.current_tail: As a friction, intake outruns use and you take in more than you decide, your odd way or the way home taught you. You keep what you know where nobody learns it.

cells.advise_catalyst: You give out faster than you take in, and running on your own fuel feels like energy until it runs out. Take a class in something nobody pays you for. Keep one evening a week with no plans. Ask someone older how they did it and listen past the first sentence. Nap before the next idea.
cells.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Action energy. Metal is the finished line: it decides, it ships, it dates the thing you keep studying. Let it spend what Wood piles up. You keep learning past the point of use because being judged feels worse than being unready. Decide one open question by a written date. Hand someone one unfinished page.

catalyst_keywords.drive: Sensing a thing first comes easier to you than waiting to be told. You sense the pause before an answer, and your guess runs past the words. What you sense first arrives ahead of your ability to say it, so let the words catch up.

You teach yourself what others take classes in. Being handed an answer never feels like knowing it, and you would rather be self-taught than shown. The self-taught way costs you time, and what you learn by it is the kind that stays.

You sleep on a question rather than answer on the spot. Forcing an answer now feels like lying to you, and you give the question a night first. Sleeping on it makes you the slow one in every quick exchange, and that slowness is chosen.

friction_keywords.drive: Thinking a question through means thinking it around, each side first. Being certain weighs more with you than being quick, so you take one more angle rather than decide. You never reach the decision in the middle of a circle, and it never closes alone.

What you understand, you keep in. Saying a thing out loud makes it ordinary, and you would rather hold an idea unfinished than hand it over half-formed. Keeping it in keeps it yours, and you never learn what it would have become.

You hide away to think, and the hiding comes before the thinking. Company costs you the thread of an idea, so you would rather be alone with a question than with people and an answer. Hiding away feeds the work and quietly stops feeding you.

catalyst_keywords.drive: What you know is not finished until it is passed on. Since being useful matters more than being ahead, you hand over a lesson the day you learn it. Passing it on costs you the head start, and your knowing comes alive in others.

You take people in, spare bed and all. Being the safe place is how you feel most yourself, so you would rather shelter someone than be sheltered. You go without a home that is only yours, and the trade feels fair to you.

You give a person time rather than a push. A push feels like a way to spoil the growing, so you wait for someone to get there instead of pulling. You see the result last of everyone, and the waiting is the care itself.

friction_keywords.drive: You help the moment you see a need, ahead of being asked. Watching someone struggle is harder for you than doing it for them, so you step in before they have tried. Helping this soon, you teach them that they needed you.

You hold the people you have grown close to tighter than they need. Letting someone go feels like losing what you built, so you keep them near rather than let them move on. You want closeness, and holding this tight crowds it out.

You stay where you are known rather than go where you would grow. Being sheltered feels the same as being fine from inside, so staying put never looks like a choice. Staying put, you trade the growing for the comfort of the known.

catalyst.head: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire makes it warm, so you recover by doing.
catalyst.current_tail: Running thin, the reserve goes first, and you go alone without asking a peer or bet bold instead of resting. You pay for each bright day with a tired one.

friction.head: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire keeps it bright and quick.
friction.current_tail: Running over, it spills into contests, so you would sooner be right alone than equal to a peer or double a stake than share it. You win most days and pay in company.

cells.advise_catalyst: You treat rest as a loss and company as a crutch. Refuel on purpose: sleep before the second wind arrives. Eat with a peer once a week and let them pay. Ask one person for help on a job you usually do alone. Sit still for ten minutes a day.
cells.advise_friction: Seek Water, the Order energy. Water runs cool and keeps to its banks, and a blaze meets it only on the water's terms. Let it shape what your Fire burns. You mistake being unstoppable for being well. Hand one project to a deadline someone else set. Ask the person above you which fire to put out first.

catalyst_keywords.drive: You start on your own, before anyone has agreed to join you. Needing nobody's go-ahead keeps you free, so you would rather start by yourself than wait for a yes. Let one start wait for company, since starting alone is how you finish alone.

Side by side is where you are most at ease. Walking side by side matters more than walking out front, so you drop the lead as fast as you refuse to follow. Take the lead sometimes, since the chances out front never come to you.

You bounce back faster than most get over the surprise. You would far sooner be upright than seen down, so you stand again ahead of getting over it. Stay down a day longer sometimes, since bouncing this fast never lets the hurt finish.

friction_keywords.drive: You go it alone by default, before anyone refuses to help. Waiting on help feels like being slowed, so you do it yourself rather than explain it to anyone. You finish sooner and carry the full weight with no one to share it.

Being told is the one thing you cannot take. Your own read feels more solid than any second opinion, so you hold it rather than test it. You lose nothing of yourself by being wrong in front of a peer.

You wall people out without meaning to, by needing nothing from them. Matching you is rare, so you keep your own company rather than settle. Keep in mind that you wanted a match all along, never a wall.

catalyst_keywords.drive: You rise to a dare before deciding if you want it. You wake in a contest like nowhere else, so you weigh the rival ahead of the stakes. Skip a race sometimes, because rising to everything means running some that were never yours.

Other people's ambition is the kind you catch fastest. You catch a rival's goal faster than you find your own, so you run on borrowed wanting rather than wait. Keep one goal nobody handed you, since half of what you chase began as somebody else's.

On a shared bet, you go all in before anyone asks. Holding back feels like not being there, so you put in your money ahead of reading the terms. Read the terms once, since all in makes you first to pay and last to know.

friction_keywords.drive: You hate to lose more than you love to win, and the gap shows. You read a rival's win as your loss, since the Fire in you outlasts a single victory. You turn every friendly game into a fight and miss the fun of playing.

You spend for show whenever the table is watching. Picking up the bill feels like winning the night, so you pay for everyone rather than let a rival pay for you. You were buying a place at the table that was already yours.

You are never off, because off feels like falling behind. You would rather run past everyone than stop and ask who was racing you, since you see no finish. As the only one timing this race, you are free to call it done.

catalyst.head: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Earth makes it slow and solid, made to last.
catalyst.current_tail: As a catalyst, the gate sticks, and you give quietly rather than show what you can do. You pay in kindness not given and talent not shown.

friction.head: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. What you give, Earth settles into a shape that holds.
friction.current_tail: As a friction, the gate never shuts, so you keep giving or keep proving instead of taking in. You run empty on comfort given and points already won.

cells.advise_catalyst: What you keep inside does not count as finished. Make one thing a week that someone else can hold. Say the opinion you have been sitting on to one person. Show a child or a friend something you know how to do. Write one line down before bed.
cells.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is slow growth, roots holding ground and leaves fed by rain, something in you before anything comes out. Let it hold what Earth pours. You do not have to turn every warm feeling into something given. Read one chapter ahead of giving an opinion. Keep one evening a week for books.

catalyst_keywords.drive: Giving comes to you before the question does. Being useful is how you feel you belong, so you give first rather than wait to be asked. You lose nothing by waiting for the question, since a gift asked for is the one that gets kept.

What you make is made to last, slowly and on purpose. The making itself is the enjoyment, so you make things for the years rather than for the showing. You deserve the showing as much as the making, because work that stays unseen stays unused.

Enough is a place you can live in. Being happy with what is here comes easier than wanting, so you enjoy what you have rather than chase what you lack. Let yourself want more sometimes, because enough has a way of shrinking.

friction_keywords.drive: Giving is the one thing you never run out of. Since being useful feels more like you than being rested, you keep giving after the supply behind it goes quiet. You are free to stop before you have nothing left to give.

Drifting along is comfortable, and comfort is enough for you. Since the easy day never argues and the hard start always does, you would rather drift than start. You drift past the things you wanted most.

Going soft on the people around you comes to you without thinking. Since comfort is the shape your care takes, you soften their way rather than let them manage it. You take on every hard thing they were able to manage.

catalyst_keywords.drive: Proving a point matters more to you than making it. Because a finished thing argues better than you could out loud, you would rather prove an idea than pitch it. You pay in time, and you get to be right in a way that lasts.

Speaking plainly comes easier to you than softening it. Since a true thing said flat feels more honest than a kind thing dressed up, you speak plainly rather than nicely. You pay for it in warmth, and to you the truth is worth it.

Rules read to you as first drafts. Since you would rather fix a bad rule than follow it, you rewrite it in the doing and in plain sight. You spend a while being marked wrong, and the rewrite tends to look like sense later.

friction_keywords.drive: Pushing back is your first reply to almost anything. Because agreeing feels like giving something up, you push against a plan rather than check if you mind it. You spend the same fight on a good plan as on a bad one.

Saying too much is the honesty you were built for. A thought left unsaid feels like a lie to you, so you say the whole thing rather than the useful half. You are allowed to say the useful half and call it honest.
Overdoing it is the only way you know to be sure of enough. Since plain and finished feels like settling, you make it bigger rather than call it done. For every extra, you draw on your own strength.

catalyst.head: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Metal makes it exact, so what you take on ends finished or not at all.
catalyst.current_tail: As a catalyst, you have more drive than work for it, and you chase the next opening more than you finish anything to keep.

friction.head: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Metal keeps it exact, and nothing you claim counts until it is finished.
friction.current_tail: As a friction, you take on past your strength, and you start a new venture rather than keep the money and love already yours.

cells.advise_catalyst: Your drive outruns the places you can put it, and an opening only looked at becomes weight. Say yes to one opening and no to the next two out loud. Move a fixed sum into savings each month before you spend the rest. Take whoever you love somewhere new and close by. Empty your pockets into a jar each night.
cells.advise_friction: Seek Fire, your own Body energy. Fire is warmth kept in: fuel, rest, the light that keeps itself lit before it works on anything. Let it hold what Metal spends. You say yes to more than you can finish, and tired is where you make your worst deals. Sleep on any new venture before you answer. Eat lunch sitting down.

catalyst_keywords.drive: You spot the opening when it is only a gap. You wake more for a far chance than a near one, and you spot a newer opening while you are claiming this one. You pay in openings taken halfway, and one taken whole repays you.

Fast starts are your natural speed. You feel most alive in the first week, and this is why you start the next venture rather than sit through this one. Staying through one middle is where your fast start turns into money.

Giving freely is what you do first with what comes in. You feel money belongs to whoever needs it next, and you give it on rather than set it aside. You give best from a kept share, and the unkept share is the price.

friction_keywords.drive: The move you trust most is moving on. You need the next place in view to feel free, so you move on at the first slow week rather than stay. You walk away from what each venture cost you to start.

Spread thin is how you like it. You feel most at ease with several ventures open, and you spread yourself across all of them rather than into one. Under all the spreading, you want one venture worth staying in.

Spending it all is your first instinct. You feel money that sits is a chance going cold, and you spend it all on the next thing rather than keep it. Remember that you are allowed to let money sit until the right chance comes.

catalyst_keywords.drive: Finishing things settles you more than starting them. You carry an open task until it is closed, so you finish what you hold ahead of starting anything new. Finish as you do, and let one thing stay open long enough to grow.

Your reflex with money is saving first. You feel a sum set aside cannot be lost, so you save rather than spend, and spend only what is left. You save your way past small pleasures too, and one sum spent uncounted buys one back.

Keeping your word matters more than being liked. You carry a promise like a debt until paid, so your word gets kept ahead of your way out. You keep your word honest by asking once whether it is still wanted.

friction_keywords.drive: Your answer to ownership is holding on tight. You would rather hold on than risk losing, so you hold on to money, things and people past where holding helps. You have every right to let go of what you no longer want.

Your default with cost is playing it safe. You feel a loss more than a gain the same size, and you play safe for the small sure return rather than the big one. Playing safe costs you too, slower and in money you never count.

Keeping what works means avoiding change. You know the price of what you have and not of the better, and you keep the known rather than try a change. Long after the known stops paying you, you go on avoiding change.

catalyst.head: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water makes it cool and deep, and a rule settles in quietly.
catalyst.current_tail: As a catalyst, the pull stays faint, so you answer a crisis more than you build a career and let your rank slip.

friction.head: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water keeps it deep, and rules sink in to stay.
friction.current_tail: As a friction, the pull turns inward, so you hold your rank rather than risk it on a crisis and pay in tests never taken.

cells.advise_catalyst: You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Give each big plan a finish line before you start it. Once a month, hand a decision to someone whose call you will keep. Tell one person your deadline. Set a stop time before you begin.
cells.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can use. Let it hold what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Learn one thing a week nobody asked you for. Give each new demand a night to sit.

catalyst_keywords.drive: You get clearer the harder things press, because only pressure stops your guessing. Inside a crisis you want the next move more than the right feeling. If you bring that clear head into a calm week, you keep it for the next crisis.

You pick your moment instead of taking the first one offered. Force spent early feels wasted, so a moment picked well beats three taken early. Each time an open door counts as a moment, you stop needing the right time to announce itself.

You lead without shouting, often without anyone noticing. You would sooner be right than be obeyed, and you lead by arranging the outcome rather than asking. Whenever you say the plan aloud, your quiet leading reaches past the people already listening.

friction_keywords.drive: You go cold rather than say what hurt. Going cold keeps you in charge of the hurt, and silence gives no one a way back in. Keep in mind that you go cold wanting someone to come and find you.

You are harder on yourself than anyone has been. You would rather catch a fault first than be told, and you are hard on your work before anyone else can be. You take the blame early and never stay long enough for praise.
You never let up, on anything or anyone. Since letting up feels like losing, you keep the pressure on rather than call the job done. Remember that you are allowed to let up once a thing is finished.

catalyst_keywords.drive: You follow through long after the mood that said yes has gone. Following through matters more to you than improving, so you finish the version you announced. You come out ahead by letting a better version in, rather than finishing a worse one you announced.

You earn trust slowly and prefer it that way. You care about being counted on more than being liked, so you earn trust by record rather than by charm. The more warmth you let go first, the sooner slow trust has a place to start.

You pace yourself through things other people sprint. Arriving whole counts for more with you than arriving first, and you keep a pace you can hold for years. You have a sprint in you as well, and pacing yourself was never meant to hide it.

friction_keywords.drive: You play safe before you know the odds. Keeping what you have feels more like you than reaching, so you take the safe way ahead of the good one. You pay for playing it safe in chances you never took.

You wait for permission that is not coming. Being given permission feels safer than taking it, and you wait to be asked up rather than step up unasked. You already hold most of the permission you sit waiting for.

You bite your tongue long before anyone asks you to. You bite down rather than cost the mood, since a smooth evening feels safer to you than an honest one. You keep the peace by biting your tongue, and you alone carry what went unsaid.
